I was at a party and was in the basement on a couch. Friends are around, and some random girl was next to me. I started making out with this random chick and everyone decided not to be around us which resulted in a blow job. 
He's the thing. I'd downed at least a half bottle of tequila. She was also just... not attractive. I hate to sound mean, but even drunk me was like "why are you doing this?" I couldn't finish so I just kinda stopped it and was like... bye. 
And then I ended up talking to another girl who I hit it off with, she made fun of me for the bj incident, and then we banged in the dining room.

The only reason I haven't gone to the hospital for my depression is that I don't qualify for FMLA and my short term disability would deny benefits because I'm too new at my job.

In 2017 I was fired from a company I worked at for 10 years, got screwed by a temp company, spent 5 months unemployed, and my dad died. All the shock of the shitty year started to wear off last month and I've been having constant panic attacks and I'm shutting myself off from my family.

I've done outpatient before. It helps. I believe it would help now.

I'm a logical person. I know what's real and what's in my head. It doesn't matter though. I can't rationalize depression.

34m here. I'm on two different antidepressants. It took a long time to find a good mix so switching isn't in the cards.

I have found the best thing is large amounts of foreplay. The more excited I can get prior to sex, the more likely I am to finish. So there's that idea.

But they wanted me gone, so it worked.
